# La Samaritaine

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** La Samaritaine
- **Artist / Maker:** Alphonse Marie Mucha Czech, 1860-1939
- **Date:** 1897
- **Style / Period:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** poster
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 16907
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/16907
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/1e5bac6e-a121-8c30-f237-aa46c4fe404f/full/400,/0/default.jpg
